pages: Nell Arkwright, twenty-nine, dark hair pinned up with a steel pin, a scarlet wool coat with the sleeves pushed back past her wrists, leans over a brass measuring engine on the dome floor, sliding one square glass plate into its carrier. Middle distance: a microscope eyepiece and a ruled focusing screen. Background: the dome ribs and the grey February hill.

Nell Arkwright, twenty-nine, dark hair pinned up with a steel pin, scarlet coat with sleeves pushed back, stands at the open dome slit with one small notebook shut against her chest, looking up. Middle distance: the shutter track and a rail. Background: a crowded field of winter stars over the hill. Cold starlight on her face.

Nell Arkwright, twenty-nine, dark hair pinned with a steel pin, scarlet wool coat, sleeves pushed back, puts her eye to a microscope eyepiece and lays one fingertip on the fine screw of its crosshair. Middle distance: one square glass plate in the carrier. Background: the dome ribs and dark. Red lamp light on her hands.

Nell Arkwright, twenty-nine, dark hair pinned with a steel pin, scarlet wool coat, sleeves pushed back, sits at the engine in the dark room with one square glass plate under the microscope, a hundred faint dots across the glass. Middle distance: the crosshair drum, a stack of plates. Background: shelves, a red bulb. Red darkroom light.

Nell Arkwright, twenty-nine, dark hair pinned with a steel pin, scarlet wool coat, sleeves pushed back, holds one square glass plate flat on the bench, a ruled grid printed across its film. Middle distance: a steel rule and an open ledger. Background: the dome floor, grey daylight from the slit.

Nell Arkwright, twenty-nine, dark hair pinned with a steel pin, scarlet wool coat, sleeves pushed back, sits at a desk with one sheet of plain paper and a pencil, drawing a single clean circle around a small dot. Middle distance: the plate carrier, a pocket book. Background: the dome and the dark slit. Red lamp light.

Nell Arkwright, twenty-nine, dark hair pinned with a steel pin, scarlet wool coat, sleeves pushed back, stands at an archive shelf in the plate room and lifts down one grey paper folder. Middle distance: other folders standing in a row. Background: the dome stair and a grey window. Flat grey daylight.

Nell Arkwright, twenty-nine, dark hair pinned with a steel pin, scarlet wool coat, sleeves pushed back, opens one cardboard box on the desk and counts eleven paper envelopes out of it. Middle distance: the engine, a pencil, a folded card. Background: the dome floor and the dark slit. Red lamp light.

Nell Arkwright, twenty-nine, dark hair pinned with a steel pin, scarlet wool coat, sleeves pushed back, sits with one ledger open flat on the desk, her finger resting on a column of figures. Middle distance: a pocket book, a rubber. Background: the engine and the grey dome. Red desk lamp light.

Nell Arkwright, twenty-nine, dark hair pinned with a steel pin, scarlet wool coat, sleeves pushed back, holds one square glass plate tilted to the slit window, her fingertip on the faint dot at its north-west corner. Middle distance: the carrier, a loupe. Background: the dome ribs, the grey hill. Grey daylight.

Nell Arkwright, twenty-nine, dark hair pinned with a steel pin, scarlet wool coat, sleeves pushed back, holds one paper envelope up to the light in the plate room, reading the small upright hand on it. Middle distance: the open cardboard box, a log book. Background: shelves of plate boxes, a low window.

Nell Arkwright, twenty-nine, dark hair pinned with a steel pin, scarlet wool coat, sleeves pushed back, bends over one open dome log on the desk, one finger on a line of it. Middle distance: the string-tied box, a pocket book. Background: the plate room, a grey window. Flat grey daylight.

Nell Arkwright, twenty-nine, dark hair pinned with a steel pin, scarlet wool coat, sleeves pushed back, stands at the end of a long table with one paper envelope held out flat in her open hand. Middle distance: a slate on the wall, an inkwell. Background: high winter windows, grey light.

Nell Arkwright, twenty-nine, dark hair pinned with a steel pin, scarlet wool coat, sleeves pushed back, draws one white index card out of a card-index drawer and reads it in the office. Middle distance: rows of wooden drawers, a brass tray. Background: an office wall, a tall grey window. Flat winter daylight.

Nell Arkwright, twenty-nine, dark hair pinned with a steel pin, scarlet wool coat with the sleeves pushed back, stands at a deep sink holding one wire tray of glass plates under running water. Middle distance: a draining rack, a thermometer. Background: tiled wall, steam, a low window. Hard white light through steam.

Foreground: the scarlet wool sleeve of Nell Arkwright, wet at the cuff, with a line of pencil figures written along it. Middle distance: Nell, twenty-nine, dark hair pinned with a steel pin, working at the sink in the steam. Background: wire trays, a draining rack, a low window. White light in the steam.

Nell Arkwright, twenty-nine, dark hair pinned with a steel pin, scarlet wool coat, sleeves pushed back, sits at the engine in the autumn with one square glass plate in the carrier, the crosshair on the faint corner star. Middle distance: the drum, a red lamp. Background: the dome slit, dark trees on the hill. Red lamp light.

Nell Arkwright, twenty-nine, dark hair pinned with a steel pin, scarlet wool coat, sleeves pushed back, sits back from the engine with one hand still on the plate, two faint dots on the glass. Middle distance: the carrier, a closed ledger. Background: the dome, autumn dark. Low red lamp light.

Foreground: one fine crosshair line drawn across a single faint star dot on a glass plate, thicker than the space between them. Middle distance: Nell Arkwright, twenty-nine, dark hair pinned with a steel pin, scarlet wool coat, her eye at the microscope. Background: the dome ribs and one red bulb. Very little light.

Nell Arkwright, twenty-nine, dark hair pinned with a steel pin, scarlet wool coat, sleeves pushed back, writes in the flyleaf of one small pocket book held open in her hand. Middle distance: two square glass plates side by side in the carrier, the ledger. Background: the dome ribs, the last dark night of the winter.
